May the name of God be glorified. I thank God for the great opportunity that the Holy Mother, the Son of God, and God the Father prepared for us to come here as a family to this holy altar.
My name is Jiji, my husband is Jijo, and our child is Doria Mariyam Jijo.
We had no children for 12 years. I underwent many treatments—IVF fresh egg transfer,
frozen egg transfer, IUI, and all that. At a time when I was thinking about what to do with my life,
when I was burdened, my friend—she is a Hindu—told me about Kreupasanam. She told me,
“I am going to Kreupasanam tomorrow; I will pray for you.” Then I searched about it on YouTube and all,
and I took the Covenant online and started praying. I also began listening to Father’s meditations through YouTube.
On some days, I would listen to three or four meditations. Right there, I would kneel down and pray.
I believed firmly. After that, I came here to see the doctor. I actually came for a frozen embryo transfer.
But when I went to the doctor, the doctor told me that I should take medicines continuously for two months.
Then I asked the doctor if we could try.
Then the doctor said no—these are contraceptive medicines, and there is no point in trying. But in my heart, there was a firm faith.
I had taken the Covenant online, and I believed that my Mother could work a miracle for me.
I did not even ask my husband’s permission. I told the doctor, “No, doctor, I don’t want the medicines; let me try.”
And the very next day, my friend and I came here to Kreupasanam, as we had already planned.
When I told Jijo about it, Jijo said, “No, I’m not coming. If you want, you go alone.
I will not come to any church anymore.” That night, when I lay down to sleep, I prayed,
Mother, nothing is impossible for you. I will not speak; you must speak. You must say it and bring him here tomorrow. Then in the morning,
when I woke up, Jijo said to me, “No, I will take you,” he said. We were extremely happy.
And so, my husband, my friend, her husband, and the child all came here together. When we came and reached the entrance,
we had to remove our footwear. So I asked him to remove his shoes. Then he said, “I can’t do it; if I remove my shoes,
my feet will get dirty and dusty.” Then I said, “It’s okay, I will wash and wipe them for you. We have walked through many hospitals with dirt and dust on our feet.”
Because I am in the UK; we are settled there. I work there. We did treatments in the UK,
we did treatments in Chennai, we did treatments in Dubai.
None of those were successful. Then we came here. And my husband came inside and came to the Mother at the thirteenth counter here and prayed.
Then I saw a sister here, and I told her,
“Sister, I have taken the Covenant online. Sister, can you give me a little oil?
Because I have heard in testimonies that if we apply oil on the stomach and pray, children are granted.” Then that sister said to me,
“My child, I cannot give you that. Dear one, you come here and take the Covenant.
Within three months, the Mother will show you a miracle,” she said. I cried a lot there and prayed.
I went back. On November seventh, we booked a room in a hotel here. On November eighth, my friend and I came here together,
and by around five o’clock we came to the counter here, took a token, took the Covenant, and I went back.
In between, I used to come here occasionally. Likewise, one day, on a Thursday, I came here. That day is not usually a day when our Joseph Father is present.
But let me say this as a miracle—I was standing there in the queue, and then Father was sprinkling blessed water like this.
A priest was sitting at that counter, and we were also standing in that queue.
Suddenly, Fr. Joseph walked right past me. It was something I could not believe. After all that, when we were sitting inside this church,
I would look at the Mother and speak. Then the Mother told me, “Did not the son whom I appeared to walk right past you?
Then why are you doubting and being burdened? Be courageous.” And so,
I went home with courage. I had a statue of the Mother. When I went to buy it that day, there was only one statue in that shop.
I bought it. Under it, I wrote a letter. “Mother, my Mother, on this birthday of mine,
give me a child as a gift. For these long 12 years, I have gone to many hospitals; I cannot do it anymore.
If you have given birth to me as a woman in this world, then let me also become a mother,” with that determination I wrote a letter.
I said, “You must pass this letter on to your Divine Son as well.” I wrote it there and prayed.
In November, I tested, and it was negative. My birthday is in December. When I checked on the 19th, it was positive.
I don’t know how to explain how I felt. My husband was sitting in the dining room. I ran and came to pray.
My husband understood why I was running. Then I ran to the place where I pray,
and I called out, “Jijo, please come.” My husband ran over. I showed him this, because this was my one thing— I would say this only in front of the Mother.
So I showed it in front of the Mother’s statue.
I said, “Jijo, look.” Then Jijo knelt down there and prayed. I truly had a very difficult pregnancy, so I could not come here often.
But Jijo as much as possible every week, drove that long distance.
We live in Thiruvalla. When I was pregnant, I was in Ernakulam.
Then he would come all the way from Ernakulam to here, pray, call me on a video call, and show me the Mother.
Thus, this child is a gift that God gave us. No amount of thanks is enough. That day, I placed six intentions in the Covenant, and all of them the Mother fulfilled for me.
The intentions I placed when I made the online Covenant were also fulfilled for me by my Mother.
Even the things I had forgotten—I remembered them only when I received them, realizing, “Oh, this was something I had placed in the Covenant.”
After our marriage, as we are Marthoma Christians. We used to sing hymns, pray, and read the Bible before sleeping every night.
For about five years, we went on with the hope that God will bless us with a child.
After five years, we ourselves became tired. Because wherever we went—whether to church or anywhere— before society there were questions.
Why are you living like this? Consult with someone. But our pain— only we and God knew it.
God gave us a great blessing. In our lives, more than before,
I came to know and believe in my God more deeply. Now, when I go to receive Eucharist, my eyes overflow with tears,
because my God died for me, rose again, and is alive even today, and I firmly believe that He is sufficient to take care of all my needs.
Then we were able to help many people. God helped us to share with others everything He gave us.
We are sponsoring a child’s education.
We help financially those who come to us with needs and difficulties. Likewise, I used to buy English newsletters and Malayalam newsletters from here,
I collect addresses, and send it to all of them—especially to those who could not come and take them themselves.
Similarly, medal, salt, honey— all these we used to give to everyone. Likewise, during my pregnancy, my BP was high at times, frequently.
God did not allow me to take even a single medicine. I took holy salt, and my blood pressure came down. I see that as a great miracle.
Likewise, one thing—before I became pregnant, I took the Covenant in November. Within one month, I became pregnant. Father often says that if we keep the Covenant we take, blessings come immediately.
That is what I received. That is what I want to tell everyone—that if we believe, God is sufficient to work miracles for us. Our Mother will pray for us; I firmly believe that.
Likewise, one day while I was praying, my green candle bloomed like a rose. When I saw that, I was sure—this time God will give me a child.
I also had a dream before I became pregnant. There were many people standing in a queue like this— a queue of people who had been without children for many years.
Our Fr. Joseph was standing at the front of that queue.
I was standing at the very back. Then he called me by name and said, “Jiji, come to the front.”
When I went to the front, he told me, “My child, may God bless you with a child.” I accepted all that in faith and prayed.
This child is the one God gave me. From the day I took the Covenant and left this place, until the day I gave birth,
I would draw the cross on my belly with oil and pray every day. “Mother, give me a healthy child,” I would say.
I also said, “If I get a girl child, I will name her after my Mother.” And thus God blessed me with a child, without any complications.
I named her Doria Mariyam Jijo. The meaning of the name Doria is “God’s gift,” and I also added my Mother’s name to hers.
In this way, God fulfilled all our desires. When I took the Covenant, I used to set an alarm to wake up for morning prayer at five o’clock—
but I would wake up even by three o’clock. Gradually, I no longer needed an alarm. I would anoint myself with oil in the morning,
pray the rosary, watch the "Our Daily Bread". Even after doing all that and going back to lie down, I would not be able to sleepy.
Then I used to write in my diaries, “Nothing is impossible for God.” I kept writing that until I filled my diary. “Children are God’s gift, the fruit of the womb”—I wrote all that down and prayed.
God gave all of that to me as a miracle. I had a Caesarean section. Even when I went in for the Caesarean, I entered the surgery holding my Mother’s medal and rosary in my hands.
Likewise, whenever I went for scans, I would pin my Mother’s medal on my body and pray.
I prayed the "Our Father" and "Hail Mary".
I would pray everything before entering the scanning room. To God who gave me so many blessings,
I offer a thousand thanks. May the name of God be glorified even more. Through this Kreupasanam Mother,
may countless thousands receive blessings—that is my prayer. All of you must pray for me and my family.
Psalm 108:18, "let this be written and recorded so that a future generation, a people yet unborn, may praise Him."
This is a powerful witness to the apparition and intercession of the Holy Mother in the family of Jiji and Jijo.
For 12 long years, they went for every possible, internationally famous treatment,
and returned from all of them in great disappointment. Finally, it was from the Holy Oil at the shrine of the Holy Mother,
through the Covenant, that they received a great answer—the answer they longed for.
The very person whom this daughter met here told her, “Within three months, you will have the blessing of carrying a child in your womb.
You will have the intercession of the Holy Mother. Jesus will work a great miracle for you.”
From the time this daughter came here, she kept saying that within one month of coming here,
all the miracles happened in her life. She also saw Fr. Joseph in a dream.
I desired Father’s laying-on-of-hands service. But Father himself came in a dream and gave me comfort,
and this daughter received a dream-vision that she would be blessed with a child. Likewise, on the candle,
I had the grace to see flowers bloom as a great promise. There was no treatment they had not tried; when all of those failed,
and when they realized the great truth that after losing every merit, no merit works,
it was then that grace began to work in them. Only when merit becomes zero does grace have a place, says the Holy Spirit.
When the Holy Mother accepted and said, “Behold the handmaid of the Lord; let your word be fulfilled in me,”
It was then that God the Father chose to give Jesus a place in the womb of the Holy Mother.
The "yes" from the Holy Mother and she said, “The Mighty One has done great things for me,”
is exactly this: when Mother says “yes” to great possibilities, when she accepts and says, “I am a humble servant,”
it is then that Father reminds us of a great word of God—Gospel of John, chapter 15, verse 16: “I chose you; you did not choose me.”
To remain in that love, the great life experiences given to us— children,
home, marriage, all the circumstances of our lives—along with support in every adverse situation,
are given to us by the Holy Mother. This Covenant is a sure foundation.
For these Mar Thoma believers, it has become a great blessing to love Jesus more and to always hold fast to the Holy Mother.
We know that during pregnancy, fear is often instilled—people say, “Do not take salt; your BP will increase.”
But the vowed items here are not just normal salt; they are a sign of the Holy Mother’s great blessing.
They are an offering—whatever is given to God is returned to us as something holy.
When her blood pressure rose, by consuming the holy salt from here, the Covenant helped them bear witness that the vowed items received here are truly holy.
We must always show reverence toward the vowed items, and when we enter this place, even in matters like removing our footwear,
through the ministers and through other people, through the fragrant anointing we receive here,
through the timely words spoken when someone turns this way or that—the Holy Mother keeps speaking to us.
Let us be faithful to our Covenant; let us be people of hope.
Giving thanks for all the blessings received by Jijo and Jiji, and for the special blessings received by the child,
let us offer this testimony to Jesus and the Holy Mother with a warm round of applause.
